recommended_path: Preserve the approved architecture and legitimate source123 composite-index alternative. E01–E06 corrections are supported in the enclosed source, but E07 retains a list-peer protection gap. Complete that harness protection, the inbound character-count correction and workload resource telemetry within the admitted paths. Then obtain the planned frozen current ALL, complete EPS execution and fresh affected review. findings.title: The list-page peer scan remains outside the strengthened plan assertions
findings.rationale: The list-plan assertions identify and bound the main r and lateral rr route accesses, but contact_identities scan nodes are only logged in identityOwnerRoutePlans. Peer index usage and scan work are enforced for the separate single-conversation thread plan. PostgreSQL can choose different plans for those workloads: a list-page hash join scanning the retained peer cohort could satisfy the route assertions, index-definition checks and latency limits while the thread lookup remains indexed. Actual121 shows a valid list peer index access; it does not make the missing regression protection executable. This leaves part of the existing E07 obligation unresolved.
findings.suggested_action: Inspect the list plan's actual ci relation/alias nodes and enforce qualified indexed access and total scan work bounded by the requested page, including loops and removed rows. Preserve both justified peer index alternatives, small-owner scan allowances, existing thresholds and actual SQL parameters. Validate through the planned complete EPS run without forcing planner settings.

findings.title: Inbound text preflight still counts UTF-16 units instead of approved characters
findings.rationale: InstagramWebhookController rejects message.text.length > 1000, while the reply controller uses Array.from(texto).length and the governing TODO explicitly requires consistent Unicode code-point limits. A signed message containing 501 supplementary Unicode characters has JavaScript length 1002 and receives 413 despite remaining below the approved 1000-character limit. CP5's ASCII-only batches cannot expose this discrepancy. This is an uncovered server boundary of the still-open Unicode obligation.
findings.suggested_action: Use the approved code-point count in webhook preflight and add signed native boundary coverage for 1000 and 1001 supplementary characters, retaining complete-batch preflight and zero effects on rejection. Keep the pending UTF-8-byte proposal unapplied.

findings.title: EPS telemetry records machine capacity without workload resource measurements
findings.rationale: The frozen EPS contract requires CPU, memory and DB recording. The authored EPS artifact reports CPU count/model, total system memory and database versions; these describe capacity and configuration. It records no workload CPU consumption, memory usage or DB resource measurements. The enclosed execution reconciliation supplies no complementary measurements. A future passing latency round could therefore complete without the required resource evidence.
findings.suggested_action: Record bounded synthetic workload CPU and memory measurements together with relevant DB activity/resource observations around the existing measured workloads. Include their sampling scope and timing in the durable evidence. Preserve every workload and threshold, and introduce no additional numeric acceptance gate.
